  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3291665910",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "Populated optional bool evaluated to true in CachedTxIsTrusted check even when value was false, treating untrusted zero-conf change as trusted",
      "quote": "m_from_me = false passes because a populated optional converts to true",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3307330647"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:3307330647",
      "settled_by_quote": "Fixed. The unit test is not meaningfully helpful."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3292328153",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "TXOs are refreshed during wallet migration before m_from_me is updated, leaving them with stale legacy values",
      "quote": "RefreshTXOsFromTx(*wtx) creates or updates WalletTXO entries using the current wtx->m_from_me value.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3307335137"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:3307335137",
      "settled_by_quote": "Fixed, but the issue is not reachable and the unit test is not meaningfully helpful."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4524698348",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "RemoveTxs does not synchronize m_txos and m_unusable_txos cache sets when deleting wallet transactions",
      "quote": "CWallet::RemoveTxs() deletes wallet transactions, but it was not keeping the new TXO caches (m_txos and m_unusable_txos) in sync.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:4549696075",
        "c:4860667104"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:4860667104",
      "settled_by_quote": "Checking the states to revert them was starting to get a bit complicated, so I ended up doing the overkill thing of recomputing all of the TXOs after removing any transaction."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4614415910",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "AddToWallet marks inputs of an inactive transaction usable without checking whether another confirmed tx spends them, causing assertion aborts in GetBalance",
      "quote": "AddToWallet()'s isInactive() branch marks the inputs of an inactive tx usable again without checking whether another confirmed tx still spends them",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:4871312261"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:4871312261",
      "settled_by_quote": "I've changed MarkTXOUsable to always do an IsSpent check."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3867859324",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "Outputs unconfirmed by reorg and abandoned remain missing from balance and listunspent until wallet reload due to default min_depth in IsSpent check",
      "quote": "min_depth left at the default instead of the 1 that matches m_unusable_txos's definition.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3867859327",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "Block-conflicted outputs can trigger an assertion failure in getbalances after removeprunedfunds due to missing state check during TXO reconstruction",
      "quote": "This is missing the TxStateBlockConflicted check that PruneSpentTXOs does.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3867859329",
      "kind": "safety",
      "harm": "ReorderTransactions and m_from_me upgrades run before LoadWallet confirms load success, rewriting intact records even when loading a corrupted wallet",
      "quote": "ReorderTransactions used to sit after LoadWallet's if (result != DBErrors::LOAD_OK) return result;, and now both it and the new upgrade loop run before that return.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3867859333",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "Uninitialized m_from_me optional in CWalletTx triggers libc++ hardening assertion aborts and undefined behavior during fuzz testing",
      "quote": "m_from_me is an optional<bool> and CWalletTx(tx, state) doesn't set it.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
